text: {"items": [{"claim_id": "qa:greeting", "reason": "The agent provided the company name, their name, and an offer of help in the first turn.", "support": "supported"}, {"claim_id": "qa:identity_verification", "reason": "The agent asked for the account number before accessing account details in turn 5.", "support": "supported"}, {"claim_id": "qa:empathy", "reason": "The agent explicitly acknowledged the customer's connectivity issues and frustration in turn 3.", "support": "supported"}, {"claim_id": "qa:correct_disclosure", "reason": "The agent stated the early-termination fee amount and the timing of the final bill in turn 7.", "support": "supported"}, {"claim_id": "qa:no_prohibited_promises", "reason": "The agent guaranteed the refund would be back in the account by tomorrow in turn 11.", "support": "supported"}, {"claim_id": "qa:proper_closure", "reason": "The agent asked if further assistance was needed, summarized the actions, and said goodbye in turn 14.", "support": "supported"}, {"claim_id": "resolution", "reason": "The agent handled the cancellation, fee waiver, and refund, and the customer expressed satisfaction in turns 12 and 13.", "support": "supported"}, {"claim_id": "churn", "reason": "The customer requested cancellation and porting out, and the agent processed the cancellation, although the evidence quote provided is just about satisfaction.", "support": "supported"}, {"claim_id": "reason:network", "reason": "The customer complained about signal drops in turn 2.", "support": "supported"}, {"claim_id": "reason:cancellation", "reason": "The customer explicitly requested to cancel service in turn 2.", "support": "supported"}, {"claim_id": "reason:billing", "reason": "The customer inquired about an overcharge on her last statement in turn 10.", "support": "supported"}]}
